en: I built a small house in the village.
I didn't build the bathroom in the house.
You built your restaurant well.
You didn't build the wall of the house.

lat: bniti qasr mn r-rmel f l-b7er
en: You (f.) built a sand castle at the beach.
You (f.) didn't build your garage.
He built this house with his own hands.

lat: ma bnash l-medrasa f had l-7ay
en: He didn't build the school in this neighborhood.
She built a new room in the house.
She didn't build her villa.
We built a big house in Rabat.

ar: ما بنيناش حتى حاجة فديك الأرض
en: We didn't build anything on that land.
You (pl.) built the mosque in your village.

ar: ما بنيتوش البيت الجديد حتى دابا
en: You (pl.) didn't build the new room until now.
They built a big office in the city.
They didn't build the bridge over the river.

lat: kanbni l-7anut dyali shwiya b shwiya
en: I'm building my shop little by little.
I don't build the wall well.
You build your house with your own hands.
You don't build the market by yourself.
You (f.) build a small garden at the house.
You (f.) don't build the factory in Rabat.
He builds houses in Casablanca.
He doesn't build houses with wood.
She is building a small shop in the neighborhood.
She doesn't build the house by herself.
We build our house with my brother.
We don't build in winter.
You (pl.) are building your house in the mountains.

lat: ma katbniwsh l-7anut f had z-znqa
en: You (pl.) don't build the shop on this street.
They are building a new hospital in the city.
They don't build houses by the sea.

lat: ghadi nbni dar jdida ba3d sena
ar: غادي نبني دار جديدة بعد سنة
en: I'm going to build a new house in a year.

lat: ma ghadish nbni f had l-ard
en: I'm not going to build on this land.

lat: ghadi tbni dar kbira m3a khuk
ar: غادي تبني دار كبيرة مع خوك
en: You're going to build a big house with your brother.
You're not going to build the roof now.
You (f.) are going to build the villa near the sea.

lat: ma ghadish tbni shi 7aja bla flus
ar: ما غاديش تبني شي حاجة بلا فلوس
en: You (f.) are not going to build anything without money.

lat: ghadi ybni l-ma3mel l-jdid f agadir
en: He's going to build the new factory in Agadir.
He's not going to build the wall tomorrow.

lat: ghadi tbni t-tabeq t-tani m3a khuha
ar: غادي تبني الطابق التاني مع خوها
en: She's going to build the second floor with her brother.

lat: ma ghadish tbni l-jnan had s-sena
ar: ما غاديش تبني الجنان هاد السنة
en: She's not going to build the garden this year.

lat: ghadi nbniw medrasa jdida f l-qrya
en: We're going to build a new school in the village.

lat: ma ghadish nbniw f l-jbel 7it l-bard
ar: ما غاديش نبنيو فالجبل حيت البرد
en: We're not going to build in the mountains because of the cold.
You (pl.) are going to build a new shop in the market.

lat: ma ghadish tbniw dar f had z-znqa
ar: ما غاديش تبنيو دار فهاد الزنقة
en: You (pl.) are not going to build a house on this street.

lat: ghadi ybniw l-mustashfa f had l-7ay
en: They're going to build the hospital in this neighborhood.

lat: ma ghadish ybniw s-sinima f l-mdina
en: They're not going to build the cinema in the city.
